h: Pete Edochie says he respects son Yul for not attacking May Edochie in public
p: Veteran actor Pete Edochie has reportedly praised his son Yul's composure despite years of criticism over his second marriage. He said neither Yul nor May has used interviews to blame the other.
body: Veteran Nollywood actor Pete Edochie has reportedly sparked fresh debate after explaining why he holds his son, Yul Edochie, in high regard.

In a snippet of an interview on the show Unfiltered with Ugo Nwokolo, shared on Sunday, 22 November 2026, Pete is said to have described Yul as remarkably composed under pressure. He pointed out that despite years of criticism online and other setbacks, Yul had never publicly spoken badly of his first wife, May Edochie, or blamed her in interviews.
He reportedly added that May had also largely kept quiet during the same period.

Yul Edochie has faced heavy public criticism since taking a second wife, fellow actress Judy Austin, a decision that led to a widely publicised split from May. Last week he drew mixed reactions again after criticising men who kneel to propose.
The clip has drawn debate online.
more: Pete praised Yul's composure under pressure.
He said May has also kept quiet.
The clip has divided opinion online.
